observations: Dark blue upholstered headboard with diamond button tufting
Mattress with white circular pattern on dark fabric
White nightstand with drawers beside the bed
Tiled floor and windows on the left wall
No obvious stains, tears, or sagging visible in the photos

claims.claim: Selling because I want to relocate
claims.evidence: Seller's words only; photos cannot show motive

risks.risk: Mattress may have stains, sagging, odors, or bed bugs not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up video of mattress surface, corners, and edges, plus hand-press test for sagging

risks.risk: Bed base or headboard frame may have hidden structural damage or fabric tears
risks.proof: Video of base from all sides including underneath and joints

risks.risk: Exact size (double, queen, king) cannot be confirmed from photos
risks.proof: Tape measure showing mattress width and length

risks.risk: Nightstand may not be included in the sale
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing or photo showing it is part of the lot

proof_requests: Close-up video of mattress surface and edges
Video of bed base from all angles including underneath
Tape measure showing mattress width and length
Confirmation whether the nightstand is included
response.reason: The item is clearly a used double bed with mattress and upholstered headboard; even at worst case (mattress unusable, base sound), it can be priced as a second-hand bed frame.
